Ready for the maintainer to merge. No blocking items were found.

This PR is still a draft. The author or the maintainer must flag it ready before merge.

Safety-tier review: this PR changes STEP geometry import and chord error reporting.

## What looks good

- `crates/app/src/geometry/import/step_fit.rs` checks each interior facet edge of curved elementary faces (`Cylinder`, `Cone`, `Sphere`, `Torus`). It splits edges that stand more than `SLACK * tol` (`2 * tol`) off the surface.
- Boundary edges (`uses == 1`, plus seams keyed by `(pos, uv)`) do not split. Conforming interior splits (`step_fit::split`) keep winding, so closed shells pass `step_closed::judge`.
- `step_facets::facets_of` collects any unrefinable chord height above `SLACK * tol` as `off`. `step.rs:399` carries `kept.tol.max(off)` to `step::coarse`, so reduced fidelity (#864) flags instead of passing silently.
- In `truck-meshalgo` 0.4.0 (`triangulation_into_polymesh`), `positions` comes from `surface.subs(uv[0], uv[1])` and every face is a triangle. Thus `step_fit.rs:127-130` checks the true parameter plane.
- Production code has no `unwrap()`, `expect()`, or `panic!()`. Numeric casts and slice indexing are checked.
- `crates/app/tests/tilted_gouge.rs` tests `testdata/models/bar_cross_holes.step` with upright and tilted (`A90`, `A-90`) slots. Every slot fails at generation and post, while the meshed-bar guard passes.
- `docs/decisions/2600-step-facets-on-surface.md`, the `Changelog:` line, `Fixes #2600`, provenance comments, and conventional commit subjects are present. No goldens (`.nc`, `.cl`), UI files, snapshot PNGs, dependencies, build scripts, or process files changed.

## Results, merged with main

I built and tested locally in `.claude/worktrees/review-2664`, trial-merged with `upstream/main` (`3a240b7fb2a784037ec951e0b2f2d72ae57acbc6`). The merge was clean. No GitHub runner ran. `sccache` was disabled (`CAMCRAFT_NO_SCCACHE=1`).

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` | 22 of 22 steps green (6.4 min): `app build` ok (304 s), 455 passed, 0 failed, 5 ignored across `app lib` (380 passed, 1 ignored) and 20 suites (`bore_facet_sagitta` 2, `import_outward` 4, `import_solidcraft` 5 + 3 ignored, `import_step_closed_shell` 6, `import_step_corner_blend` 3, `import_step_curve_guard` 3, `import_step_doubly_curved` 1, `import_step_guard` 6, `import_step_guard_default_cap` 1, `import_step_open_shell` 4, `import_step_outward` 3, `import_step_thread` 1, `large_models` 3 + 1 ignored, `model_fidelity` 9, `step_budget` 6, `step_chord_units` 3, `step_fidelity` 2, `step_nesting` 8, `stock_export` 2, `tilted_gouge` 3) |
| `cargo test -j 6 -p camcraft-app --test post_not_judged` | 4 passed, 0 failed (5.90 s) |
| `cargo clippy -j 6 -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean (2 m 07 s) |
| `git diff --stat upstream/main -- "*.nc" "*.cl"` | empty (no goldens moved) |

Independent mutation checks on `tilted_gouge` (reverted after each run, then re-tested clean: 3 passed, 0 failed):

| Mutation | Result |
|---|---|
| Return `KEPT` at start of `step_fit::fit_face` | RED: `the_step_bars_wall_facets_lie_on_the_cylinder` (`2.57401532315658 mm inside the cylinder`), `a_tilted_slot_into_the_step_bar_is_refused` (`S90 cuts 0.5 mm into the bar and must be a gouge: []`); meshed guard stayed green |
| Set `const ROUNDS: usize = 0;` at `step_fit.rs:58` (measure `off` without splitting) | RED: `the_step_bars_wall_facets_lie_on_the_cylinder` (`full fidelity: 24.999999999999986`), `a_tilted_slot_into_the_step_bar_is_refused` (`S90 cuts 0.5 mm into the bar and must be a gouge: []`); meshed guard stayed green |

## Requested before merge

None.

## Notes (not blocking)

1. `crates/app/src/geometry/import/step_fit.rs` has no `#[cfg(test)]` unit tests. The facet-budget fallback (`off > 0` when `room` stops refinement) has no test in this PR, though a temporary probe with `step::with_facet_budget(20_000, ...)` passed and reported `chord > CHORD_CAP`.
2. `crates/app/src/geometry/import/step.rs:384` logs the summary warning only when `kept.tol > wanted`, not when `off > wanted` alone (`step_fit.rs:84` logs its own warning when `fit.off > 0.0`).
3. `crates/app/src/geometry/import/step.rs:400` now reaches 400 lines.
4. `docs/decisions/2600-step-facets-on-surface.md` notes that B-spline, NURBS, and swept faces stay out of scope here. The second QA finding (`A0 B180` with `basis_version` 0) also stays separate.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
